description: A ground-level photograph depicting an agricultural landscape in Greece on 2018-06-11. The foreground shows reddish-brown cultivated soil, with scattered green olive trees, which are a type of permanent crop. In the middle ground, there are rows of what appear to be young permanent crops, possibly vineyards, and beyond that, a large field of lighter-coloured annual crops. The sky is overcast. A small watermark "WWW.PANORAMICAS.COM" is visible in the bottom-left corner. This image illustrates the land cover classification category "Annual crops associated with permanent crops." Credit is given to CCME 2018, provided under Copernicus.
